description: Bridges the ASYNC IModelingPropertySchemaProvider and the SYNCHRONOUS ModelingOperationContext.ResolvePropertySchema the operation engine consumes (§5.5/§6.4). PropertySchemaPairs lists the (notation, semanticType) pairs a model/batch can judge and PreloadAsync resolves them into a dictionary-backed delegate (a provider that throws degrades that pair to 'no schema'); a host writer and the modeling_apply_operations MCP tool both use it, so the engine and the editor validate with the same schemas.
